title: AA1Car Disclaimer, Copyright and Permissions
content:
AA1Car makes every effort to assure the technical accuracy of all information on this website. Almost all of the content on this website is ORIGINAL and was written by Larry Carley who has over 40 years of experience as a nationally known automotive technical writer, editor and author. Larry also has a lifetime of hands-on experience diagnosing and repairing automobiles. Every effort has been made to make sure the AA1Car articles are technically accurate and a reliable resource for training, education and diagnostic purposes.
If you see a mistake or question the accuracy of anything published on this website, email us so that we may review the material and make any changes, corrections or updates that may be needed. See FAQs for how to contact us.
NOTE: ALL THE CONTENT ON THIS WEBSITE IS COPYRIGHTED AND ORIGINAL.
Content may NOT be copied, reposted, shared, scraped, plagiarized, republished or reused in any manner without the written consent of Larry Carley.
You may add links to pages on this website, or quote small excerpts (no more than a few sentences or a couple paragraphs) from articles on this website as long as you also include attribution (where you got it) with a link back to the original article.
Violations of copyright will result in (1) a take down notice, and (2) if you ignore that a complaint filed with your web service which may result in your website, blog, facebook page or twitter or instagram account being taken down. A lot of hard work goes into building a website like this, so we take copyright enforcement seriously!
The articles on this website are provided for educational purposes only. We are NOT in the auto repair business nor do we publish automotive service manuals. Nothing we say has been reviewed, approved or authorized by any vehicle manufacturer. The information and opinions expressed on this website are solely those of the author based on his personal experience and research (unless information is attributed to another source, person or company). Consequently, AA1Car and its author and contributors are NOT RESPONSIBLE for anything you might do to your vehicle or yourself.
Auto repair requires common sense and caution. If you lack either and do not know one end of a screwdriver from the other, do not attempt your own auto repairs or maintenance. Take your vehicle to a professional repair facility for service and repairs.
Note all CAUTIONS and WARNINGS in the articles. They are there to protect you!.
NOTE: Some automotive service procedures are potentially dangerous. If you lack the skill or know-how to safely perform a certain repair, DO NOT risk harm to yourself or your vehicle. Take your vehicle to a professional technician to have it diagnosed and repaired.
See Auto Repair Safety Tips for details.
Links on this website are included to provide additional information and resources for our visitors. We do NOT vouch for or endorse any of the products, services or information that may be accessed via these links. The same applies to any ads that appear on this website. Third party advertiser networks place ads on our site based on keywords and user data. If you see an objectionable or questionable ad, report it to Google.
AA1Car does NOT track individual visitors to this website, or gather personal information or IP addresses. We do not plant any cookies or spyware on your computer, and we do not sell any data to third party marketers.
However, some advertisers on this website (namely Google) does track your IP address when you click on an advertisement, and may use cookies to monitor your activities once you visit their website. For further information about our PRIVACY POLICY, CLICK HERE.
